headline: Munjal Auto responds to NSE volume surge inquiry
hook: Exchange queries Munjal Auto over volume spike
summary: The National Stock Exchange sought clarification from Munjal Auto Industries following a significant increase in trading volume. The company has submitted its formal response to the exchange. This process is a standard regulatory measure to ensure market transparency and protect retail investors from unexplained price or volume volatility.
whats_next: Exchange to publish company response on the NSE website
why_it_matters: Regulatory scrutiny may signal upcoming volatility in the stock price.
